facts.fact: Malta Business lists eight digital marketing services: SEO, email marketing, pay-per-click advertising, online reputation management, social media marketing, analytics and reporting, content marketing, and video marketing.
Malta Business describes its digital marketing process as six steps: initial consultation, customized strategy, implementation, ongoing optimization, transparent reporting, and collaboration.
facts.quote:
Initial Consultation
*   Customized Strategy
*   Implementation
*   Ongoing Optimization
*   Transparent Reporting
*   Collaboration

facts.fact: Malta Business says it tracks international website traffic, conversion rates and ROI across regions to measure its digital marketing campaigns.
facts.quote: We track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as international website traffic, conversion rates and ROI across regions.
